description: Source code for shared channel attachment handling in Mattermost, including attachment synchronization, remote upload, and plugin communication.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Service handling shared channel attachments, synchronization, and remote upload sessions.

methods.name: shouldSyncAttachment
methods.description: Determines if a file attachment needs to be synchronized based on last sync time.

methods.name: sendAttachmentForRemote
methods.description: Sends a file attachment to a remote cluster, handling both plugin and non-plugin remote clusters.

methods.name: sendAttachmentToPlugin
methods.description: Sends a file attachment to a remote cluster via plugin.

methods.name: saveSharedAttachment
methods.description: Saves a shared channel attachment record in the database.

methods.name: onReceiveUploadCreate
methods.description: Handles incoming requests to create an upload session for shared channel attachments.
